# `⊗` — Outer product

Monadic operator. Keys: `Alt-o m`. Hanzi: `表`

`X g⊗Y` applies `g` to every pair. `⊗` calls `g` directly on two atoms. With array arguments, the result has shape `ρX , ρY`.

```bpl
5+⊗5               ⍝ 10
5+⊗⊂5              ⍝ ⊂10
1,⊗2               ⍝ 1 2
1 2+⊗10 20         ⍝ [11 21◇12 22]
ι3ₓ =⊗ ι3ₓ           ⍝ [$t $f $f◇$f $t $f◇$f $f $t]
```

Each pair's result is one item of the result. See [inner product](dot.qmd).

Where it can, `⊗` calls `g` once on all the pairs together, in a [batched call](../evaluation.qmd#functions-and-effects).

## Inverse

`X f⊗⁻ Y` gives the right argument whose outer product with `X` is `Y`. `(f⊗↢X)⁻Y` gives the left argument.

```bpl
1 2+⊗⁻1 2+⊗10 20   ⍝ 10 20
```
